summary: Everything this printing plant reports goes into the air as ozone, about 46,600 lb in 2024.

impacts.title: Air & breathing
impacts.how: Ground-level ozone irritates the airways, causing coughing, a sore throat and chest tightness. Packaging printers usually make it with equipment that treats plastic film before printing. Ozone breaks down within hours, so the effect stays close to the plant.

avoid.label: Check air quality
avoid.text: Check the daily air quality index (AirNow), especially on hot, still days

avoid.label: Exercise in the morning
avoid.text: Plan outdoor exercise for mornings, when ozone is lower

avoid.label: Report odors
avoid.text: Report strong or unusual odors in the forum, where the company can reply. You can also call the DNR tip line, 1-800-847-9367

impacts.title: Kids & people with asthma
impacts.where: Family Services of Northeast Wisconsin is within 1 mile
impacts.how: Children, older adults and anyone with asthma feel ozone first, and it can trigger asthma attacks.

avoid.label: Keep an inhaler handy
avoid.text: Keep rescue inhalers handy on high-ozone days

avoid.label: Kids play indoors
avoid.text: Move kids' outdoor play indoors when the air quality index is orange or worse

avoid.label: Ask about permits
avoid.text: Ask the DNR whether the plant's ozone is covered by an air permit
